# v1.3.1 Release Notes — Mac Electron Startup Blank-Screen Hotfix

**`bot-team v1.3.1`** is an immediate patch release on top of **`v1.3.0`** fixing the P0 macOS Electron startup blank-screen issue reported in `#F-548` (`#C-548-1`), verified end-to-end on the packaged macOS `arm64` `.app` bundle while keeping the frozen 20-file Tier-1 `AgentDaemon` untouched (`ADR 0012`, `daemon-boundary` `10/10`, `daemonOutdated === false`).


## What Changed in `v1.3.1`

- **Fixed Mac Electron Blank Screen on Startup (`BOT-455`, commits `b3b6bb8`, `47de587`, `edd0a07`, `#F-548`)**:
  - Previously, `app/electron/preload.ts` exposed the IPC bridge directly at `window.botTeam` via `contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld`, making `window.botTeam` non-writable (`writable: false, configurable: false`). When `DesktopApiMux` mounted at renderer boot and assigned `window.botTeam = mux`, Chromium threw `TypeError: Cannot assign to read only property 'botTeam' of object '#<Window>'` before React rendered.
  - Exposes the native Electron preload bridge on `window.__botTeamNative` instead, installs `DesktopApiMux` cleanly onto `window.botTeam` in `app/src/main.tsx`, forwards the native `updater` bridge cleanly through `DesktopApiMux` (`window.botTeam.updater` / `window.botTeamUpdater`), and declares `Window.botTeamUpdater` in `app/src/env.d.ts`.
- **Automated Preload Boot Regression Suite (`cli/test/desktop-preload-boot.mjs`)**:
  - Locks the read-only `contextBridge` simulation (`Object.defineProperty(..., { writable: false, configurable: false })`), `DesktopApiMux` initialization, and `updater` forwarding contract so this failure mode cannot regress.


## Verification

- Full verification gate passed: `sync-shared --check`, `@bot-team/cli build`, `daemon-boundary` (`10/10`), `core-hot-reload`, `desktop-preload-boot`, `@bot-team/app` renderer & Electron `tsc --noEmit`, Vite build, and `pnpm lint:comments` (`0`).
- Packaged macOS `arm64` `bot-team.app` verified launching cleanly in an isolated `BOT_TEAM_HOME` with zero `botTeam` read-only errors and live rendered UI.
- Synced to Railway `cloud-gateway` (`bot-team-services`) and published to `AgenticPunk/bot-team-release` (`v1.3.1`).

---
